properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 25 at 11:21AM PDT until May 28 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Southwest corner of Imperial County.

* WHEN...From 3 PM Tuesday to 5 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Difficult driving conditions, especially for larger
vehicles traveling along roads with crosswinds. Light, unsecured
objects may become airborne.
properties.instruction:
A Wind Advisory means that sustained wind speeds of between 30 and
40 mph are expected, or wind gusts of between 40 and 58 mph. Winds
this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high profile
vehicles.

In addition, strong winds over desert areas could result in briefly
lowered visibilities to well under a mile at times in blowing dust
or blowing sand. Use extra caution.

properties.areaDesc: Greater Lake Tahoe Area; Greater Lake Tahoe Area
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 20 mph with gusts up to 45 mph and
waves 1 to 4 feet for Lake Tahoe.

* WHERE...Greater Lake Tahoe Area.

* WHEN...From 5 PM this afternoon to 2 PM PDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Small boats, kayaks and paddle boards will be prone to
capsizing and should remain off lake waters until conditions
improve.
properties.instruction:
Check lake conditions before heading out and be prepared for a
sudden increase in winds and wave heights. Consider postponing
boating activities on the lake until a day with less wind.
